indicators.note: putting things in order means rearranging them, so these letters are sorted into a new sequence

explanation.surface: Someone tidies a stack of confidential documents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Private' looks like an adjective describing the papers, but it is a noun: the soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: A sapper is a soldier of the Royal Engineers, and a private is the lowest rank of soldier.

indicators.note: about means going around, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: to apprehend a suspect is to arrest them
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: Police detain a crowd of a thousand fans.
explanation.definitionFit: Armrests are the parts of a chair that hold up, or support, your arms.

definitions.meaning: to say something is to state it
the word that comes after United in the name of the USA

explanation.definitionFit: To state is to say, and the United States is the country's full name, so the word follows United.

clue.text: Able to pay for a form of abuse

definitions.meaning: having enough money to meet all debts
the word that comes before abuse in glue-sniffing and similar inhaled misuse

explanation.definitionFit: A solvent firm can meet its debts, and solvent abuse is the inhaling of glue or chemical vapours.

parts.note: a lad is a boy
Ida is a girl's name

explanation.definitionFit: La-di-da describes affected, pretentious, snooty manners or speech.

indicators.note: in places the withering piece inside the general

parts.note: Ulysses S. Grant was the Union general in the American Civil War
plants that wither die

explanation.surface: Someone is tempted to fade away into vagueness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Incline' looks like a verb ('tend to'), but it is a noun, a slope; 'in general' looks like a phrase meaning 'usually'.
explanation.definitionFit: A gradient is a slope, and an incline is a sloping surface.

clue.text: Managed to come back with fair share on account

indicators.note: coming back means going the opposite way, so this word is read backwards

parts.note: ran a business means managed it
a ration is the fixed portion allotted to each person

explanation.surface: Someone returned and took their fair cut of the takings on credit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to come back' turns RAN into NAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A narration is a spoken or written telling of events, which is to say an account of them.

clue.text: The atmosphere in a small firm may be capital

indicators.note: in places the atmosphere inside the small firm

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
air is the atmosphere around us

explanation.surface: Working at a little business might be a big deal for the mood there.
explanation.definitionFit: Cairo is the capital city of Egypt.

clue.text: Prove a tie looks odd for a manual worker

indicators.note: something that looks odd is out of shape, so these letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: Proof that a necktie looks peculiar on a labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: An operative is a factory or machine worker doing hands-on work.

clue.text: Classes where children take a point to heart

indicators.note: taking something in is the first half of the instruction to enclose it
taking something to heart means putting it at the centre, inside the other piece

parts.note: kids are children
N, north, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: In school, pupils are told to learn a lesson seriously.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take ... to heart' puts N inside KIDS.
explanation.definitionFit: Kinds are sorts or categories, as are classes.

clue.text: Complaint may be socially acceptable in time

indicators.note: in places the acceptable letter inside the period of time

parts.note: an age is a period of time
U means upper-class and thus socially acceptable, from Nancy Mitford's U and non-U

explanation.surface: Grumbling may in time become polite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Complaint' looks like a grievance; here it is an illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Ague is a fever with shivering, an illness, and a complaint can mean an ailment.

clue.text: Credit is twice provided in an emergency

parts.note: CR is the abbreviation for credit in accounts

indicators.note: twice means the word is written two times in a row

explanation.surface: A loan is offered again and again when things go wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: A crisis is a time of acute danger or difficulty, an emergency.

parts.note: reads as a posh district, but means a district that excludes everyone, a place outsiders dare not or may not enter

explanation.definitionFit: A no-go area is a district where entry is barred or dangerous, so it excludes people literally.

parts.note: tissue is a fine woven fabric

explanation.surface: A piece of cloth is the subject of an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: A point at issue is one being argued over, so the phrase means under dispute.

definitions.meaning: physically meeting or coming up against something

explanation.definitionFit: Touching means in contact with something and also moving or affecting, like emotive.

parts.note: SE, south-east, is a compass course or heading

explanation.surface: A college degree programme suits the person paying the fees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'course' looks like a university course of study, but it is a direction of travel.
explanation.definitionFit: A user is someone who employs a thing, putting it to use.

clue.text: Refuse to hold pose — demonstrating stupidity

indicators.note: holding something means keeping it inside, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: to refuse a request is to deny it
to sit for a portrait is to pose

explanation.surface: An artist's model who won't keep still shows a lack of sense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' looks like a noun (rubbish) in the surface, but it is the verb meaning to deny; 'demonstrating' is only a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Density, meaning thickness of mind, is a colloquial word for dullness or stupidity.

parts.note: reads as a weight of dried fruit, but pound means an enclosure and sultanas the wives of a sultan, so the place they are kept

explanation.definitionFit: A seraglio is the harem quarters of a Muslim palace where the sultan's wives lived secluded.

definitions.meaning: an old snake-shaped bass wind instrument of that name
the tempter in Eden who led Eve to eat the forbidden fruit

explanation.definitionFit: The serpent was an early bass wind instrument, and in Genesis a snake tempted Eve to sin.

parts.note: bulls are stock market speculators who buy expecting prices to rise
to eye something is to watch it closely

explanation.surface: Stock traders watch the price of gold closely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gold' looks like the metal traders watch, but it is the centre of an archery target.
explanation.definitionFit: In archery the gold is the innermost ring of the target, the bull's-eye.

clue.text: A trial could result in the noose

indicators.note: results could come out differently, so these letters are rearranged into a new word

explanation.surface: A court case may end with a hanging.
explanation.definitionFit: A lariat is a lasso, a rope with a running noose at the end.

definitions.meaning: to coat metal with a shiny chromium layer

explanation.definitionFit: Chrome yellow is a vivid pigment, and to chrome a car part is to plate it with chromium.

indicators.note: cards that are dealt are shuffled and handed out, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A card player handles their bid coolly.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting calmly means acting with composure and self-control.

clue.text: It's lucky mother's gone to bed

parts.note: ma is a word for mother, with the possessive S
a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: A family is fortunate that Mum has finally retired for the night.
explanation.definitionFit: A mascot is a person, animal or object thought to bring good luck.

definitions.meaning: fly is slang for knowing, astute
keen or cutting, as a cold wind or remark

explanation.definitionFit: Sharp means quick-witted, like the slang fly, and also cutting or pungent, like biting.

clue.text: Defender in a game gains essential point

parts.note: polo is a game played on horseback
the gist is the main point of a matter

explanation.surface: A player in a sports match grasps the key tactic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Defender' looks like a team position in the game, but it is someone who argues a case.
explanation.definitionFit: An apologist is a person who argues in defence of a belief or cause.

clue.text: Where to find a washer permanently available

definitions.meaning: a rubber washer sits on a tap, the plumbing fitting
ready to be drawn upon at any time, like beer from the barrel

explanation.definitionFit: Something on tap is readily available, and a plumbing washer is literally fitted on a tap.

parts.note: reads as backing for an anglers' society, but describes a metal brace that sounds like a golf club for someone who fishes

explanation.definitionFit: Angle iron is an L-shaped steel bar used as a structural brace or support.
